## Invoice intake and scheduling

POST /v1/invoices returns HTTP 202 with data.props and initial status queued.
options.type accepts IMMEDIATE (default) or SCHEDULE. SCHEDULE uses a future
competenceDate (YYYY-MM-DD) and releases emission at 00:00 America/Sao_Paulo.
data.props.scheduledFor is the release timestamp (ISO string), or null for
IMMEDIATE; scheduled invoices remain queued until that instant. Dates beyond
the configured horizon (15 days by default) return HTTP 422 with fiscal issue
code schedule_horizon_exceeded. Intake atomically persists invoice, event and
outbox message. Once a queue publication is acknowledged, a Redis reset can
lose the job while the invoice stays queued; document recovery does not recover
queued invoices.
